**Sentiment Justification:**

The company shows encouraging signs of growth in assets and revenue, as well as reducing losses. The increase in cash and slight reduction in loss and improvement in net margin are positive indicators. The slight decrease in operating margin is cause for slight concern and the still negative net income needs to be addressed.  The increase in liabilities needs to be monitored.
